'''2016 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Aaron Kingery]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Old Allies / We Need Your Help|V4-L-oldallies.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Old Allies Kingery LS 2016 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
